observations.whyAssigned: Official statement confirms operational Whoosh on 2 October 2023 and explicitly locates Padalarang Station in West Bandung regency. Canonical BPS code 3217 is Kabupaten Bandung Barat. This verifies a local high-speed/interregional rail access point, not universal access, affordability, or full-year operation.

observations.whyAssigned: President confirms actual Hajj, Umrah and Kuala Lumpur flights at Kertajati on 11 July 2023. The contemporaneous Cisumdawu statement explicitly places the airport in Majalengka regency, mapped to canonical code 3210. The English airport heading uses City loosely; no Kota Majalengka is created. Planned October flight transfers are not treated as completed evidence.

observations.whyAssigned: BPJT confirms Cisumdawu sections were already operating free before tariffs began on 14 August 2023. Setkab locates the inaugurated road/twin-tunnel site in Rancakalong, Sumedang regency, mapped to canonical code 3211. This verifies operating toll-road infrastructure within Sumedang, not equitable access or a province-wide road inventory.
